tool.name: nf-core paraphase
tool.description: HiFi-based caller for highly homologous genes
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ paraphase \\ $args \\ --threads $task.cpus \\ --bam $bam \\ --reference $fasta \\ --prefix $prefix \\ $config_file \\ --out .
for vcf in ${prefix}_paraphase_vcfs/*.vcf; do bgzip \\ $args2 \\ --threads $task.cpus \\ \$vcf; tabix \\ $args3 \\ --threads $task.cpus \\ \$vcf.gz; done
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": minimap2: \$(minimap2 --version 2>&1) paraphase: \$(paraphase --version) samtools: \$(echo \$(samtools --version 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*samtools //; s/Using.*\$//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
HiFi-based caller for highly homologous genes
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: paraphase Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/paraphase ]]>
